gates.evidence: Surface s19 is the Settings page, which is SFW and age-appropriate.
The reward is time-boxed in-app feature access; no clicks, installs, ratings, or cash-like rewards are involved.
The proposal uses gain framing ('Play a 15-second game to unlock...') with a clean 'No thanks' decline option and no dark patterns.
The user explicitly opts in by tapping the 'Play to try' CTA on the invite overlay.
The exact reward (30 minutes of Upgrade to Luzia+) and required action (15-second game) are clearly stated before the ad starts.
Declining via 'No thanks' is free and returns the user to Settings without penalty or degraded state.
Triggered on Settings (s19) once the current answer has finished, ensuring no streaming AI response is interrupted.
Eligibility explicitly states: 'All users, including subscribers, on every app open', which violates the rule against offering ads to subscribers for benefits they already pay for.

scores.evidence: The proposal targets the 'Upgrade to Luzia+' upsell on Settings (s19, moments m23/m1), aligning the reward directly with user interest in premium features.
Triggered on the Settings page after responses conclude, maintaining immersion and preserving chat flow.
Eligibility explicitly includes existing subscribers ('All users, including subscribers'), creating an extreme risk of subscription cannibalization and violating payer protection.
Code-computed COGS is $0.0000 per view, well within healthy margins against US net revenue per view ($0.0090–$0.0150).
Settings is a frequently visited surface (m12, reach=frequent), though general settings reach is lower than an immediate message cap hit.
Maps cleanly to SIM-RWD unit on s19 with standard SSV and remote config support.
Properly utilizes app-specific nouns and IDs from the digest: s19, Upgrade to Luzia+, Luzia+ Subscription (r1).
Explicit per-day caps (perDay: 2) and cooldowns (cooldownMin: 60) are defined.
Defines a primary metric, guardrails (-3% relative plan conversion), and a 10% user-level holdout for 4 weeks.

requiredChanges: Restrict eligibility strictly to non-subscribers/non-payers; remove subscribers from the eligibility criteria.
Add a paid contrast line on the grant screen pointing to the permanent subscription (Luzia+ Subscription).
parsed.topConcern: Offering rewarded ad trials to existing subscribers violates core subscriber protection rules and creates severe subscription cannibalization risk.
